@graph.name: Cura
@graph.description: Cura is an AI-powered claims resolution platform for airlines, automating compensation end-to-end while improving passenger outcomes and controlling cost at scale. It connects to the systems airlines already run — CRM, payout, PSS, email ingestion, FlightAware, WorldTracer, METAR/TAF weather and more — to handle intake, fraud detection, verification and closure.
